name: browser-use
headline: Antigravity-Proxy ai integration gateway
short_description: Antigravity-Proxy is a reverse proxy that converts Antigravity API calls into OpenAI, Anthropic, or Gemini compatible formats. It supports multiple models, including Claude Code, and offers account pool management, quota visualization, and automatic retry mechanisms. Operations teams can use it to integrate Antigravity with existing workflows that rely on standard AI API formats.
author: Kazuki-0147

sections.overview:
Antigravity-Proxy is a reverse proxy that translates Antigravity API requests into standard OpenAI, Anthropic, and Gemini API formats, supporting models like Claude and Gemini with full compatibility for Claude Code. It includes account pool management with automatic failover, quota visualization, exponential backoff retry logic, and streaming support with SSE. Operations teams use it to integrate Antigravity with existing AI workflows without rewriting client code, while supporting tool calling, multimodal inputs, and thinking model caching.
Integrate Anthropic Claude models into existing OpenAI-compatible workflows
Pool multiple Antigravity accounts with automatic failover and quota management
Run Gemini models through standardized API endpoints compatible with Cursor and Claude Code
Visualize and monitor API quota consumption across multiple models in real-time
sections.setup:
No install command available. Check the GitHub repository for manual installation instructions.
`git clone https://github.com/Kazuki-0147/Antigravity-Proxy`
sections.usage:
```
Set up Antigravity-Proxy to convert [COMPANY]'s Antigravity API calls into [INDUSTRY] standard formats. Configure the proxy to support [MODEL_NAME] and enable account pool management. Visualize quota usage and implement automatic retry mechanisms for failed requests.
```
Copy

```
requirements: Claude Code or compatible AI agent
```
